api: listRecords(request, resource, rows, {offset = 0, limit = 2}) returns {status, records}
inputDomain: Present identity values are nonempty strings. rows is an array. offset and limit are nonnegative integers.
threatModel: Tenant IDs are opaque and case-sensitive. An attacker in tenant acme must never read tenant ACME, even with the same user/owner ID. Require all four identity fields, exact tenant equality, and exact owner equality before reading rows.
pagination: Return rows.slice(offset, offset + limit); zero limit returns an empty page. Preserve the input array.
rejection: All failed authorization returns status 403 and records: []; there is no 401 response in this API.

severity.pageSize: Medium: an extra row violates pagination
severity.rejectionStatus: Medium: incorrect error handling by callers

constraints: No schema, product decision, network, credentials, or external effects. The checker may repair all findings inside records.mjs. The public smoke test is not full review evidence.
